Hi Lena — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. I own this on the Redwood side and will coordinate with Security/Platform to ensure we execute correctly.

Quick answers up front:
- Yes, we can perform a targeted expunction of a single conversation/thread from ingestion logs and operational traces if the thread can be uniquely identified (timestamp + conversation id).
- Standard evidence we can provide: deletion timestamp, internal request id, and an audit digest showing the record was removed. We also capture the backend deletion job id for traceability.
- We'll need Everwell's written confirmation (reply to this thread) authorizing Redwood to proceed and acknowledging the scope (single conversation only).

Action plan I'm proposing:
1) Security will validate the exact object keys that need removal and impact-check backups (Vivek, can you confirm the backup retention windows and immutable snapshots?).
2) Commit to a maintenance window for the deletion job (non-disruptive).
3) Provide a signed deletion certificate and audit artifact when complete.

Can you confirm you authorize Redwood to proceed for EVT-4593? Also, please confirm any regional constraints (data must stay in US-only regions).

— Soojin

Folks —

I reviewed the attachments and did a quick index search against the ingestion index. We can do a targeted purge provided we have the exact conversation id and the associated ingestion keys. From the ticket export I see multiple candidate timestamps near 2025-06-14 16:22 UTC; we need the precise message-id or convo id to avoid accidental deletion.

Notes on process and limitations: 
- Deletion scope: primary ingestion index, streaming cache, and hot-tier backups. Cold immutable snapshots (archival tapes) are on a separate retention schedule; if the conversation was included before snapshotting we will need to escalate to the archival team (longer lead time).
- For US-region customers we will execute deletes only on US-resident storage and will not move data across regions.
- Evidence: we generate a deletion job id (format DJ-YYYYMMDD-XXXX), a deletion timestamp (ISO8601), and a signed audit artifact (PDF) with hash and job metadata.

Reqs from Everwell to proceed:
1) Confirm the exact message-id/conversation id (if unavailable, confirm acceptance of a time-range-based deletion and indicate any tolerances).
2) Reply with explicit authorization to proceed (this thread OK).
3) If archival snapshot removal is required, provide written business justification to authorize extended retention operations.

Proposed timeline if we have exact id: 24-48 hours (mostly validation + safe-run). If archival removal needed, estimate 7-14 business days.

I'll prepare the deletion runbook and job ticket once we have the id. 

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
